words.definition_en: featuring new methods, ideas, or products; advanced and original.
collocations: take an innovative approach（採用創新的做法）
words.sentence_en: The team decided to take an innovative approach to solving the problem.
words.sentence_tw: 該團隊決定採用創新的方法來解決這個問題。
words.analysis: 形容詞表示具有創新思維或突破性做法的。動詞為 innovate，名詞為 innovation。
words.timing: 討論科技突破、產品設計、教學方法或創業思維時。

words.definition_en: to tell someone that you will certainly do much or something; a declaration that one will do something.
patterns: promise to V（承諾要做某事）
words.sentence_en: The dark clouds promise rain later in the afternoon.
words.sentence_tw: 烏雲預示著午後將會下雨。
words.analysis: 作動詞時除表「許諾」，還可表「有……的希望/預示」；作名詞時常用 make a promise。
words.timing: 表達誠信誓言、約定，或說明某事預示著某種發展結果時。

words.definition_en: the matter from which a thing is or can be made.
words.comparison: material（物品/建造材料） vs. ingredient（食物食材）
words.sentence_en: Wood is a traditional material used to construct houses.
words.sentence_tw: 木頭是用來建造房屋的傳統材料。
words.analysis: 泛指工業、建造或手作所使用的物理原料，與食物調味的食材（ingredient）不同。
words.timing: 說明產品成分、建築原料、手作材料或作文寫作素材時。

words.definition_en: a building or other object constructed from several parts.
words.sentence_en: The engineers tested the stability of the tall structure.
words.sentence_tw: 工程師們測試了這座高大結構體的穩定性。
words.analysis: 可指實體的建築結構或橋樑，也可比喻文章、組織或團隊的組織結構。
words.timing: 討論建築工程、組織架構、文章邏輯結構時。

words.definition_en: having the ability, fitness, or quality necessary to do or achieve a specified thing.
patterns: be capable of + N/V-ing（有能力做……）
related_words: capability (n. [C, U]) 能力（如：beyond one's capabilities）
words.sentence_en: With proper training, you will be capable of leading this project.
words.sentence_tw: 經過適當的訓練，你將有能力領導這個專案。
words.analysis: 核心句型為 be capable of + N/V-ing，著重於個人潛能或客觀能力狀態。
words.timing: 描述人的潛力、職涯能力評估或機器設備的功能範圍時。

words.definition_en: work jointly on an activity, especially to produce or create something.
collocations: collaborate with sb. for/on sth.（與某人合作某事）
related_words: collaboration (n. [C, U]) 合作（如：in close collaboration with...）
words.sentence_en: Scientists from different countries collaborated to develop the new medicine.
words.sentence_tw: 來自不同國家的科學家合作開發這種新藥。
words.analysis: 強調雙方或多方攜手並肩完成共同目標。名詞為 collaboration。
words.timing: 討論團隊合作、跨國專案、跨界聯名（Co-branding）時。

words.definition_en: build or erect something typically large such as a building, road, or machine.
related_words: constructive (adj.) 有建設性的（如：constructive feedback）
words.sentence_en: It took several months to construct the bridge.
words.sentence_tw: 建造這座橋花了數月的時間。
words.analysis: 較 make/build 更具正式感與規模感。衍生形容詞 constructive 表有建設性的。
words.timing: 描述工程施工、建造大樓或比喻建立理論/觀點時。

words.definition_en: give (someone or something) a specified rank or place within a grading system.
words.sentence_en: The university is ranked among the top ten in the world.
words.sentence_tw: 這所大學名列世界前十名之一。
words.analysis: 可作動詞評定名次，也可作名詞指階級、名次。名詞 ranking 常指排行榜。
words.timing: 討論競賽名次、學校與企業排行榜或地位階級時。

words.definition_en: alter or move (something) slightly in order to achieve the desired fit, appearance, or result.
words.sentence_en: It takes time to adjust to living in a new city.
words.sentence_tw: 適應新城市的日常生活需要時間。
words.analysis: 作及物動詞指調整微調；作不及物動詞搭配 adjust to + N/V-ing 表適應新環境。
words.timing: 描繪新環境適應、調整計畫策略或微調設備參數時。

words.definition_en: depend on with full trust or confidence.
words.sentence_en: You can always rely on your best friends when you are in trouble.
words.sentence_tw: 當你遇到困難時，你總是能倚靠你最好的朋友。
words.analysis: 極高頻動詞，核心句型為 rely on/upon。衍生形容詞為 reliable（可靠的）。
words.timing: 討論團隊互信、依賴科技/數據或指靠某人協助時。

words.definition_en: information about reactions to a product, a person's performance of a task, etc.
words.sentence_en: We received valuable feedback from our customers regarding the new product.
words.sentence_tw: 我們從顧客那裡獲得了關於新產品的寶貴回饋意見。
words.analysis: 不可數名詞，指針對表現、服務或產品所提供的反饋建言。
words.timing: 作文撰寫檢討反省、產品測試或課堂檢討時。

words.definition_en: an essential or characteristic part of something abstract.
words.sentence_en: Trust is a key element in any successful relationship.
words.sentence_tw: 信任是任何成功關係中的關鍵要素。
words.analysis: 指構成整體不可或缺的成分或要素。衍生形容詞 elementary 為小學的/基礎的。
words.timing: 分析成功因素、化學元素或討論故事構詞要素時。

words.sentence_en: Political stability is crucial for economic development.
words.sentence_tw: 政治穩定對經濟發展至關重要。
words.analysis: 不可數名詞，指結構、情緒、局勢或經濟上的安定狀態。形容詞為 stable。
words.timing: 討論社會經濟局勢、建築平衡或心理情緒控制時。

words.definition_en: a way or course taken in getting from a starting point to a destination.
words.sentence_en: Hard work is the most reliable route to success.
words.sentence_tw: 努力工作是通往成功最可靠的途徑。
words.analysis: 可指具體的導航/交通路線，也可比喻通往特定目標的抽象途徑。
words.timing: 描繪旅行路線規劃，或比喻達到目標的必經之路時。

words.definition_en: travel through an unfamiliar area in order to learn about it; inquire into or discuss in detail.
words.sentence_en: The students were encouraged to explore different possibilities.
words.sentence_tw: 學生們被鼓勵去探索不同的可能性。
words.analysis: 既指實地考察未知的地理區域，也指深入研究課題或探索可能性。名詞為 exploration。
words.timing: 討論職涯探索、戶外冒險探險或科學研究時。

phrases.sentence_en: The team relied on trial and error to see what worked best.
phrases.sentence_tw: 該團隊依靠反覆試驗來找出最佳方案。
phrases.analysis: 指在沒有既定答案時，透過不斷實作、犯錯並修正來尋求解答的過程。

phrases.sentence_en: They don't waste time deciding who is in charge.
phrases.sentence_tw: 他們不會浪費時間討論誰該做主負責。
phrases.analysis: 指掌控局勢或總管某項業務/專案。主詞為人時用 operate in charge of sth.。

phrases.sentence_en: They focus on working together to figure out how to build the structure.
phrases.sentence_tw: 他們專注於合作想出如何搭建這個結構。
phrases.analysis: 指經過思考、分析或討論後理解並解決了某個難題。

phrases.definition_tw: 挽起袖子（準備開始幹活/行動）
phrases.sentence_en: In order to solve problems, we must roll up our sleeves.
phrases.sentence_tw: 為了要解決問題，我們必須挽起袖子準備動手幹活。
phrases.analysis: 生動的比喻片語，強調實事求是、積極投入實作行動。

phrases.sentence_en: Let's stop chatting and get down to work right away.
phrases.sentence_tw: 我們別再聊天了，馬上開始認真工作吧。
phrases.analysis: 介系詞 to 後面必須接名詞或動名詞 (V-ing)，強調收心專注於工作或課題。

phrases.definition_tw: 轉移 / 進展到（下一件事）
phrases.sentence_en: After finishing the first section, we can move on to the next topic.
phrases.sentence_tw: 在完成第一部分後，我們可以進展到下一個主題。
phrases.analysis: 指結束當前階段，往前推進到下一個任務或階段。

phrases.sentence_en: The innovative plan worked smoothly, just as expected.
phrases.sentence_tw: 這個創新的計畫運作得很順利，正如預料的一樣。
phrases.analysis: 常用於句首或句尾，說明發展結果與預先想的一致。

phrases.sentence_en: Online learning is convenient; on the other hand, it requires high self-discipline.
phrases.sentence_tw: 線上學習很方便；但另一方面，它需要高度的自律。
phrases.analysis: 用來引導對比觀點或另一側面的論述，常與 On the one hand... 搭配使用。

patterns.title: 句型 1：not ... until ...（直到……才……）
patterns.structure: S + V (否定式) ... until + N / S + V
patterns.explanation: until 後面接時間點或子句，表示「直到該時間或事件發生之前，主句動作均未發生/被暫緩」，中文習慣翻譯為「直到……才……」。
patterns.sentence_en: Adults usually don't start putting the structure together until they have spent most of the time planning.
patterns.sentence_tw: 大人通常要到花了大部分時間做計畫後，才開始動手組裝結構。
examples: I did not get home until midnight.
People do not realize the importance of good health until they become sick.

patterns.title: 句型 2：比較代名詞 that / those 代替重複的名詞
patterns.structure: 單數：A + be + 比較級 + than + that of B | 複數：A + be + 比較級 + than + those of B
patterns.explanation: 在進行兩者比較時，為了避免重複前面出現過的名詞，單數或不可數名詞用 that 代替，複數名詞則用 those 代替。
patterns.sentence_en: They had structures that were taller than those of most adult teams.
patterns.sentence_tw: 他們的結構比大多數成年人團隊的（結構）還要高。
examples: The weather in Canada is similar to that in Sweden.
The population of Taipei is much larger than that of Hualien.
The apartments downtown are more expensive than those in the suburbs.
In South Korea, smokers' life expectancy is about 8 years shorter than that of non-smokers.
